text: Alex's neighbour Lena is planning a weekend out, and Alex gets invited on a Sunday walk. In this unit you will say what you like doing in your free time, plan a weekend, and invite someone to a concert, a film or a walk, or politely say no. The scenes are set in places you may know: a societies fair, a student club, the Language Centre kitchen and a sports centre.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
